parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to force delete associated routes.

- **true**: Force deletes the routes.

- **false**: Does not delete the routes.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Express Connect instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: RouterInterfaceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Express Connect instance.
